Migration guide

Move your assets from MyNearWallet to near.com

A careful, step-by-step guide to moving your assets.

near.com is NEAR’s flagship product for managing, trading, and sending crypto assets across more than 30 blockchain networks—and earning yield on them. It is much more than a crypto wallet. It is a unified account for managing your financial life onchain. A near.com account is controlled by either a passkey or a crypto wallet.

This guide will walk you through moving the assets in MyNearWallet to a near.com account you control with a passkey.

The process in a nutshell

To keep the move safe and avoid juggling addresses, you will use two near.com accounts. That may sound complicated. The process is simple:

  1. Create a near.com account controlled by a passkey. This is Account 1.
  2. Sign in to near.com with MyNearWallet. This creates Account 2, controlled by MyNearWallet.
  3. Deposit your MyNearWallet assets directly into Account 2.
  4. Transfer each asset from Account 2 to Account 1 using a saved near.com contact.
  5. Once you have confirmed that all your assets arrived, use Account 1 going forward.

Account 2 is temporary. MyNearWallet is being retired, so Account 1 is the account you’ll use going forward.

Set up your new account

1

Create Account 1 with a passkey

  1. Go to near.com and select Sign in or create an account.
  2. Select Passkey for Touch ID and Face ID.
  3. Select Create new passkey and follow your device’s instructions.
  4. When the near.com home screen appears, sign out and sign in again with the new passkey.

Check: Do not move any assets until you have confirmed that the passkey signs you back into Account 1.

2

Create Account 2 and save Account 1 as a contact

  1. While signed in with your passkey, open your account menu and select My address.
  2. Select Show address.
  3. Select Share with other near.com users. Save the contact link somewhere private for the next step.
  4. Sign out of Account 1.
  5. Sign in again. This time select NEAR Wallets, then MyNearWallet, and approve the connection. This creates Account 2, controlled by MyNearWallet.
  6. Open the contact link you saved.
  7. Name the contact something unmistakable, such as My new near.com account, add your near.com user account and select near.com user as the network, then select Save contact.

Check: The contact must be shown as a near.com user. If near.com asks you to choose a blockchain network, stop and do not save it.

Move your assets

3

Move a small test amount through Account 2

  1. While signed in with MyNearWallet, select Receive.
  2. Choose the asset you want to test and select the NEAR network.
  3. Select Deposit from connected wallet.
  1. Enter a small amount, select Deposit, and approve the transaction in MyNearWallet. This moves the test amount into Account 2.
  2. Wait until near.com shows that the deposit is complete.
  3. Select Send, choose the asset you deposited, select “To another near.com users” and select My new near.com account as the recipient.
  4. Review the asset, amount, and recipient. Approve the transfer.
  1. Sign out, then sign in with your passkey and confirm that the test amount has arrived.

Check: If Deposit from connected wallet is not available for an asset, stop and contact support before moving that asset. The test is complete only when the asset appears in Account 1. A submitted or pending transaction is not complete.

4

Move the remaining assets

Sign back in with MyNearWallet. Repeat the same Receive → Deposit from connected wallet → Send to your saved contact sequence for each asset.

Move one asset at a time. Wait for each deposit and transfer to complete before starting the next one. Review the asset, amount, and recipient every time.

5

Confirm everything in Account 1

  1. Sign in with your passkey.
  2. Confirm that every expected asset and balance appears.
  3. Check that no deposit or transfer is still pending.
  1. Keep access to MyNearWallet and its recovery information until you are satisfied that the move is complete.

If something looks wrong

Stop before approving another transaction. Do not repeat a pending deposit or transfer.

Contact near.com support and include the asset, amount, approximate time, and transaction reference. Never send your seed phrase, private key, or passkey to anyone.
